verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is a real-time communications platform. Event-driven or scheduled automation is a fair axis for such a platform, so the story applies, but the evidence documents no autonomous background automations a user can set up. The only nearby items are a demo serverless meeting app and a mention of converting SIP media application Lambda configurations to Flows. These are developer building blocks and migration guidance, not a documented automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
